winter_walk_1.description: this sprite sheet of the same character walking in four directions, now dressed for winter: a long plum-purple wool coat over their clothes, buttoned, and a chunky mustard-yellow knit scarf wrapped at the neck; keep exactly the same poses, frames, hair, goggles, face, skin and boots, and the same pixel-art style and outline

winter_portrait_1.description: the same character, same face, expression, hair, goggles and skin, now wearing a plum-purple wool winter coat with a chunky mustard-yellow knit scarf wrapped around the neck instead of the rust turtleneck and cream apron; same pixel-art style, colours and outline weight

beach_walk_1.description: this sprite sheet of the same character walking in four directions, now dressed for a tropical beach: a loose pale sky-blue short-sleeved linen shirt, open at the collar, and sand-coloured shorts, bare arms below the sleeves and bare legs, simple sandals; keep exactly the same poses, frames, hair, goggles, face and skin, and the same pixel-art style and outline

beach_portrait_1.description: the same character, same face, expression, hair, goggles and skin, now wearing a loose pale sky-blue short-sleeved linen shirt open at the collar, showing the neck and collarbones, instead of the rust turtleneck and cream apron; same pixel-art style, colours and outline weight
